coreCapabilities.title: Conflict forecasting
coreCapabilities.description: Forecasts of political violence at country and 0.5° sub-national level, 1–6 months ahead, with prediction intervals and comparable past episodes for context.

coreCapabilities.title: Exposure mapping
coreCapabilities.description: Forecasts mapped to a client's holdings, locations or supply chain, so risk is read where the exposure sits. Delivered as client engagements.

coreCapabilities.title: Additional signals
coreCapabilities.description: The engine is signal-agnostic. Satellite-derived and market signals can be integrated into forecasts built for a specific client or portfolio.

coreCapabilities.title: Dashboard, data and API
coreCapabilities.description: A live dashboard, CSV and JSON data access, monthly reports, and a versioned archive of past releases.
